globe.status.snpp: NASA FIRMS no longer delivers new Suomi NPP VIIRS fire data. Historical data stays available, and FIRMS points users to NOAA-20 and NOAA-21.

globe.status.noaa21: In orbit; NASA has handed its operations over to NOAA (formerly JPSS-2).

method.title: Method
method.steps.title: Pipeline steps
method.step.download: Download the archived FIRMS hotspots for Mongolia from every MODIS and VIIRS satellite.
method.step.filter: Flag hotspots that are not vegetation fires (industry, always-hot places). Nothing is deleted.
method.step.units: Count MODIS by pixel and VIIRS by fire unit, and keep the raw VIIRS pixel count too.
method.step.label: Label every hotspot with its province, day or night, satellite and local date.
method.step.ratios: Work out conversion ratios where two satellites overlap: Aqua to Suomi NPP per month and day/night, Suomi NPP to NOAA-20 as one ratio.
method.step.chain: Chain them: Aqua, then Suomi NPP, then NOAA-20. One satellite counts at a time, so nothing is counted twice.
method.step.baseline: For each month, find the normal range: the median and the middle half of past years.
method.step.validate: Test the harmonization on years when both satellites worked, and publish the results as they are.
method.tests.title: Tests
method.tests.note: WAPE = total error ÷ total true count. Lower is better.
method.test.aqua_rebuild.name: Aqua rebuild
method.test.aqua_rebuild.what: Hide one year of Aqua, rebuild it from Suomi NPP with ratios from the other years, compare. Repeated for every overlap year.
method.test.forward.name: Forward test
method.test.forward.what: Work out the ratios on the earlier overlap years only, then rebuild Aqua in the later years.
method.test.one_ratio.name: One-ratio baseline
method.test.one_ratio.what: The same Aqua rebuild with a single ratio for all months. Monthly ratios must do better.
method.test.noaa20_ratio.name: NOAA-20 ratio test
method.test.noaa20_ratio.what: Hide one year of Suomi NPP, rebuild it from NOAA-20 with the other years' ratio, compare.
method.test.result_compare: {metric}: {value} with one ratio, {monthly} with monthly ratios
method.test.not_ready: This result is not in the data files yet.
